continuity_scope: Chaosium RuneQuest: Roleplaying in Glorantha core-rulebook witness (current Chaosium product; 2018 edition family), supported only by the official product description and the free RuneQuest: Roleplaying in Glorantha Quickstart as a rules preview. This does not merge RuneQuest Classic, earlier editions, HeroQuest/QuestWorlds, novels, games, fan material, or player campaigns.

work_or_witnesses.edition: Chaosium core rulebook product page; current RuneQuest/Glorantha rules witness.
Chaosium official free rules preview and The Broken Tower adventure; used here for system/setting scope only.
Chaosium product page; product/preview boundary and available print errata.

coverage_rule: Terms-only audit. The selected core-rules witness and accessible preview establish setting/rules concepts but not an audited, fixed dramatic character cohort. No character or relationship records are made. Cultures, occupations, cults, gods, runes, spirit kinds, monsters, items, places, and rules remain terms/dimensions; player and pre-generated characters require a separate exact scenario pass.
omissions: All named Gloranthan figures, gods, spirits, pre-generated adventurers, and scenario NPCs, including The Broken Tower material, because they are not a claim-level cohort in this core-rules audit.
RuneQuest Classic/earlier editions, HeroQuest/QuestWorlds, novels, games, fan publications, and individual home-campaign outcomes.
Cults, deities, peoples, occupations, runes, spirit types, monsters, items, places, and mechanics as character nodes.
uncertainties: The core product page describes rules/setting structure rather than offering a chapter-level, named-character corpus. Terms are therefore product-level only.
Chaosium sells classic products as convertible/compatible material; compatibility is not identity, and no cross-edition retcon reconciliation is attempted.
The official Quickstart page offers print errata, but this pass does not use its contents to harmonize the core rulebook. Any date/version-sensitive errata claim needs its own witness.
evidence_basis: Chaosium's core-rulebook page establishes culture, cult, rune, skill, magic, and mythic Glorantha context. The official Quickstart identifies Glorantha as the RuneQuest setting and its Runes as pervasive, while the official play page distinguishes the Starter Set/Quickstart and campaign materials. No wiki or fan source is used.
